reported.quote: The revenue from operations as disclosed earlier is INR49,533 crores, delivered in the stand-alone business.
EBITDA margin of 8.3%, so almost INR4,100 crores of EBITDA.
We delivered 5.4% PAT, about INR2,695 crores.
Like-for-like growth that we disclosed is for stores which are open for more than at least 24 months. We delivered 9.9% like-for-like growth.
We opened 41 stores in last year gone by.
The total retail business area at the end of the fiscal '24 was about 15.1 million square feet.

business: Avenue Supermarts Limited operates a chain of supermarkets under the brand name DMart, offering foods, non-foods FMCG, general merchandise, and apparel products. The company also operates an e-commerce grocery and home delivery business under the brand name DMart Ready.
